Academic Programs

Explore Our Accredited Nursing Courses

Both GNM and ANM curricula are designed in strict accordance with Indian Nursing Council (INC) regulations, preparing students for exemplary careers in hospitals, community healthcare, and international healthcare institutions.

Practical Hours: Students complete over 1,500 hours of supervised bedside nursing in Medical-Surgical wards, Intensive Care Units, and Labor rooms.
Diploma Program Duration: 3 Years (Incl. Internship) Seats: 60 per Batch

General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM)

The GNM program is a comprehensive diploma course intended to prepare nurses capable of delivering quality bedside care, trauma response, maternal & child nursing, and administrative leadership in multi-specialty hospitals.

Eligibility Criteria

10+2 with English & min 40% marks (PCB preferred; Arts/Commerce candidates also eligible under INC guidelines).

Age & Gender Norms

Minimum 17 years completed as of 31st December 2026. Max age 35 years. Both Male and Female candidates eligible.

Clinical Postings

ICU, CCU, Emergency Trauma, Labor Delivery Suite, Pediatric NICU, Psychiatric Ward, and District Hospital.

Career Scope

Staff Nurse in Govt/Private Hospitals, Military Nursing, Industrial Health Nurse, Global Nursing (UK/Gulf/Canada).

Community & Midwifery Duration: 2 Years Seats: 40 per Batch

Auxiliary Nursing Midwifery (ANM)

The ANM program prepares compassionate frontline community healthcare workers with specialized skills in antenatal care, safe deliveries, maternal & child nutrition, immunization programs, and primary health center (PHC) operations.

Eligibility Criteria

10+2 passed in any stream (Arts / Commerce / Science) with minimum 40% aggregate from any recognized state board.

Age & Gender Norms

Age 17 to 35 years. Dedicated to female candidates interested in community nursing, maternal care, and rural health missions.

Practical Training

Primary Health Centers (PHC), Sub-Centers, Community Health Centers (CHC), Maternity Wards, and Village Health Posts.

Career Scope

National Health Mission (NHM) Nurse, Sub-Center Incharge, Village Health Nurse, Primary Health Worker, Home Healthcare.

Maternal & Child Focus: ANM students lead vaccination and prenatal counseling across 6 affiliated rural Primary Health Centers.

Quick Comparison: GNM vs ANM

Feature GNM (General Nursing & Midwifery) ANM (Auxiliary Nursing Midwifery)
Course Duration 3 Years (includes 6 months clinical internship) 2 Years (includes 6 months rural field posting)
Minimum Eligibility 10+2 passed (40% aggregate, PCB preferred / Arts & Commerce eligible) 10+2 passed in any stream (Arts / Commerce / Science, 40% aggregate)
Approved Seats 60 Seats (INC Quota) 40 Seats (INC Quota)
Clinical Scope Hospital bedside care, ICU, Surgery, OT, Emergency, Midwifery Maternal-infant care, Immunization, Sub-centers, Rural PHC outreach
Career Advancement Eligible for Post-Basic B.Sc Nursing, M.Sc Nursing, Hospital Nursing Superintendent Can upgrade to GNM through in-service promotional criteria or lateral entry
Annual Tuition Base ₹ 65,000 / Year (Scholarships Available) ₹ 45,000 / Year (Scholarships Available)

Campus Infrastructure

World-Class Nursing Laboratories & Hospital

Practical dexterity is the soul of nursing. Renaissance College of Nursing features specialized clinical laboratories equipped with computerized medical simulation mannequins.

Nursing Foundation & Sim Lab

10-bedded simulated clinical ward with adult and pediatric patient mannequins, cardiac monitors, oxygen delivery setups, and CPR trainers for essential bedside skill mastery.

MCH & Obstetrics Lab

Dedicated birthing simulators, pelvic models, newborn resuscitation equipment, and incubators for practical training of GNM & ANM midwifery trainees.

Central Medical Library

Over 5,000 nursing and medical reference books, international journals, DELNET e-library access, and quiet digital research terminals for students.

College PC + Internet Architecture

How Public Users Access College PC Database

[Public Internet User] (Mobile Phone / Laptop)
│
▼ (HTTPS Web Requests)
[Cloudflare Tunnel / College Public Domain]
│ (Encrypted Zero-Trust Bridge)
▼
[College Local PC] (In Nursing Office)
├── Node.js / Python Server on Port 5000
└── SQLite Database (college_database.sqlite)

Key Advantages of this Architecture:

  • Data Sovereignty: All candidate personal data, phone numbers, and marksheets stay 100% on the College premises PC.
  • No Router Port-Forwarding: Cloudflare Tunnel works through an outbound tunnel, meaning you don't have to open dangerous router ports.
  • Zero Cost: No cloud database hosting charges (AWS/Azure) or monthly server bills.
  • Offline Resilience: Even during internet outages, college office staff can continue processing admissions locally on the College PC!
